name: Karon
intro: Karon is defined by its long, open beach, one of the longest on Phuket's west coast, set between Patong and Kata. It is a resort area with large hotels along the beach road and quieter residential lanes on the hillsides behind.
overview:
Karon is a west-coast beach area in Mueang Phuket district, between Patong to the north and Kata to the south. The condominiums we list here are Vibe Residence Karon, The Kuartz, Ever Prime Residences and Ashiyana Heights, together with one pool-villa project, Mali Thai Kata; most are pre-sale or under construction, with completion dates advertised from 2028.
Ashiyana Heights and Mali Thai Kata are described as lying between Karon and Kata, and the project data gives about 1.1-1.4 km to Kata Beach for them; Vibe Residence Karon is listed about 1 km from Karon Beach (its developer advertises 180 m, so confirm on site). Distances are still missing for some projects, so ask us for travel times to the beach, shops and the airport.
suitableFor: Buyers who want sea views at lower prices than Kata or Surin
highlights: Long sandy beach with space even in high season
Hillside condos and villas with sea views
Karon viewpoint and Big Buddha nearby

lifestyle: Karon has a relaxed resort feel with restaurants, markets and shops along the beach road and around the Karon circle. It is quieter than Patong at night but busier than Kata Noi or Nai Harn.
beaches: Karon Beach is a long, straight stretch of sand, good for walking and swimming in the dry season. Like the rest of the west coast it has strong waves and currents in the monsoon months. Kata Beach is just over the southern headland.
rentalMarket: Karon's rental market is driven by tourism, with demand concentrated in the high season. Long-term demand is modest and mainly comes from people working in local hotels and restaurants.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term holiday rentals
rentalDetails.text: Units within walking distance of the beach, or with sea views from the hills, let best. Large hotels mean competition is strong.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: A smaller market than the south of the island; tenants are mostly tourism workers and long-stay visitors.

rentalDetails.title: Seasonal pattern
rentalDetails.text: Strong from about November to April, slower during the monsoon months.

rentalDetails.title: Suitable property types
rentalDetails.text: Resort-style condos near the beach; sea-view villas for families and groups.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: a recognised beach destination with space and views. Limitations: seasonality, hotel competition, hilly access to some projects, and about 46-49 km to the airport.

investment: Karon is considered by buyers who want a sea-view holiday property between Patong and Kata. Prices for comparable views can be lower than in the most sought-after west-coast bays, but rental income is more seasonal.

investmentDetails.title: Typical investor profiles
investmentDetails.text: Holiday-home owners and buyers of small condos for seasonal letting.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Seasonality, competition from hotels, and steep access roads to some hillside sites.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Common fees, sinking fund, management commission, cleaning between guests and maintenance.

faq.question: Is Karon Beach good for swimming?
faq.answer: In the dry season (about November to April) Karon Beach is good for swimming. From about May to October the waves and currents can be strong, so always check the flags.

faq.question: Is Karon quieter than Patong?
faq.answer: Yes. Karon has restaurants and some nightlife, but it is much calmer than Patong's Bangla Road area.

faq.question: How far is Karon from Phuket airport?
faq.answer: Our project data gives about 46 to 49 km to Phuket International Airport, usually around an hour by car.

faq.question: Do Karon properties have sea views?
faq.answer: Many hillside projects behind Karon have sea views; beachfront hotels occupy much of the flat land along the beach road.

faq.question: Should I choose Kata or Karon?
faq.answer: Kata has a smaller, livelier town and two bays; Karon has a longer beach and more space. Our Kata vs Karon guide explains the differences.
